name: SOTA Computer use agent challenge
tagline: A computer-use agent that carries out multi-step desktop tasks from one instruction, built for a benchmark challenge.
problem: Computer-use agents struggle with realistic, long desktop tasks.
solution: Screen capture and OCR for grounding, a vision-language model for reasoning, an action planner, and retry logic, run locally.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask it to download, unzip and pivot a dataset and watch it work.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Cua: Best State-of-the-Art Computer-Use Agent” among 261 submissions.
Scored on a benchmark rather than a pitch.

lessons: Benchmark prizes reward robustness work (grounding, retries) over polish.
